chunks: 4481 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ibrahim al-Karkhi, who said:

I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who has four wives, and he spends the night with three of them on their nights and has relations with them; then when he spends the night with the fourth on her night, he does not touch her. Is there any sin upon him in this? He said: "Only this is binding upon him: that he spend the night with her on her night and remain with her through her morning. There is no obligation upon him to have relations with her if he does not wish that."

key_terms.أَرْبَعُ نِسْوَةٍ: four wives in a polygynous marriage context
key_terms.صَبِيحَتَهَا: her morning, meaning the morning following her night
key_terms.لَيَالِيهِنَّ: their assigned nights in the rotation
key_terms.يُجَامِعَهَا: to have conjugal relations with her

ai.seo_question: Is a husband sinful if he does not have relations with one of his wives on her assigned night?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding fairness between wives in overnight lodging. It states that the obligatory right is spending the assigned night and morning with the wife, while conjugal relations are not mandatory if the husband does not wish to engage in them.
